critical_code_review_comments: iter6_router.py is well-scoped, every endpoint applies tenant_filter() and uses Depends(require_tenant). No leaks observed in section/aging-detail tenant isolation tests.
WeasyPrint PDF generation is synchronous on the request thread — fine for current scale; if reports get large (>100 activities) consider background task + signed URL.
/photos/:id/extract-exif is best-effort: catches all EXIF parse exceptions and stores 'error' field. Good defensive coding.
_segment_intersect uses standard parametric line-segment intersection — clean implementation. Returns None on parallel/colinear (den < 1e-9).
auto-link-activities falls back to a 2-segment short code match (e.g. '03 30') when full code doesn't match — sensible heuristic for partially classified tasks.

apply_recovery only edits planned_finish for split_activity/resequence/change_method categories; extend_shift / add_crew are no-ops with a note. Audit log should be written via audit.py — not visible in iter6_router.py — verify audit trail coverage.

Eval-harness 'realized_days' uses pct_complete * duration / 100 as a proxy — admittedly crude. Document this in the response or expose a 'method' field so consumers know it's a heuristic, not measured reality.
Submittal SUB-NNNN auto-numbering still uses count_documents+1 (race window) — flagged in iter4 review, still applies in iter6.

Frontend missing-testid issues are pure DX/QA concerns — UI functionality works (verified visually in screenshot: sidebar badges render, recovery cards/Apply buttons render, marketplace page loads, etc.). Not real user-facing bugs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter6 backend endpoints verified end-to-end via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py (use as regression). Key findings: (1) Recovery apply-flow SKIPS in regression because all current suggestions are already status='applied' — re-seed or generate a fresh suggestion to exercise it; (2) marketplace POST schema requires posting_type ∈ {sub_invitation, equipment_rental, labor_request, materials} — NOT 'kind'/'visibility'/'trade_codes'; (3) cost-rates POST schema requires {code, name, unit, base_rate_usd, optional prevailing_wage_rate_usd, trade_code} — NOT labor_class/rate_usd_per_hour; (4) submittals don't have a single GET-by-id endpoint — verify persistence via project list re-fetch; (5) tenant isolation on spatial/section returns floors=[] for foreign tenant (correct); (6) WeasyPrint PDFs work cleanly, both endpoints stream %PDF bytes; (7) photo phash similarity match works (Hamming dist <=8); (8) aging-detail tenant isolation correctly returns all-empty arrays for foreign tenants. Frontend critical paths all functional but several data-testid attributes are missing — see action_items. The React hydration <span>-in-<option> warning persists from iter4.
rca of the issue: No RCA needed — no critical bugs found. Initial 3 backend failures were test-side schema mismatches (corrected: marketplace posting_type, cost-rate code/name/base_rate_usd, submittal verification via project list instead of single GET). All 19 active iter6 endpoints pass on first execution after schema fixes; all 31 iter3+iter4 regression tests still pass.
